title: Fix a token-bucket rate limiter
acceptanceCriteria: A new key can send `capacity` requests at once; the next one is denied
Each key has its own bucket — one busy key never denies another
A bucket never holds more than `capacity` tokens, however long the key sits idle
Partial tokens carry over: a client polling every 300 ms at 1 token/s still averages one request per second
A denied request reports `retryAfterMs` as the time until the next whole token, counting any partial token already refilled (and 0 when allowed)
A denied request doesn't spend a token
